purpose: Coordinate validated subsystem authorities into deterministic world ticks without replacing their ownership boundaries.

lod.FULL: Individual NPC and ecology decisions plus aggregate/environment routines.
lod.ACTIVE: Individual decisions with reduced budgets plus aggregate/environment routines.
lod.AGGREGATE: No individual NPC/ecology decisions; bounded aggregate ecology/environment/recovery only.
lod.ROUTINE_OFFLINE: Only routine-safe bounded processes and recovery; individual autonomous decisions remain blocked.

scope_lod_rule: Effective LOD is never higher fidelity than the global world simulation mode; per-scope LOD may only reduce fidelity.

determinism.participant_sort: priority desc, next_due asc, entity_ref asc

causal_backpressure.clock_event_generated_after_drain: processed on following tick unless unrelated

extensions.missing_handler: preflight ConflictError before a run is created
extensions.offline: requires explicit routine_safe and ROUTINE_OFFLINE mode membership
